text:
incident-bot: PAGERS: continuous-batching perf cliff on prod-cluster-7 (region us-west-2). 95/99 latencies for /v1/generate spiked >10x and queue depth grew. alert: cont_batch.queue_delay.p99 > 3s, cont_batch.evictions/sec up 1200%. triggered by sudden surge from customer XYZ.

alice: I'm on it. starting triage — pulling recent telemetry and pod-level stats.

jamal: I saw this trend a few minutes ago on the console, looks like KV cache eviction skyrocketed and microbatch sizes collapsed to 1 repeatedly. could be prefetch + high concurrency clash.

maria: adding ML infra context: we rolled the prefetch heuristic change 2d ago that bumped aggressive prefetch thresholds. wondering if under very high concurrency it's thrashing the KV cache.

alice: copying commands I'm running:
```
# top OOM/eviction events
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/cont-batch-runtime -c runtime --since=5m | grep -i eviction | tail -n 50
# per-pool queue depths
curl -s http://telemetry.internal/pools/prod-cluster-7 | jq '.pools[] | select(.name=="slot-a")'
```

ops-bot: deploybot: Canary deployment 2026-03-15T09:18:15 - cont-batch:prefetch-heuristic v2 -> 5 pods (ok).

alice: logs show a flood of `kv_cache::evict` followed by `microbatch: flushed, size=1` repeatedly. prefix cache miss rate shot from 4% to 72% during spike.

jamal: hypothesis: prefetch heuristic aggressively prefetches for many concurrent requests, filling KV with low-value prefixes; combined with continuous batching, the runtime's batching logic ends up fragmenting microbatches under lock contention -> more RPCs and evictions.

kevin: customer-signal: support got multiple tickets about slow responses and timeouts for embedding jobs for large customers around 09:12. impact: elevated latency and a few 500s for high-concurrency customers.

alice: mitigation plan (short term): 1) throttle incoming concurrency for affected pools, 2) disable prefetch heuristic on prod-cluster-7, 3) increase microbatching timestep window slightly to allow bigger batches.

maria: agree. quick change: flip `PREFETCH_HEURISTIC=off` in env for pool slot-a and slot-b, and set `MICROBATCH_MAX_DELAY_MS=8` -> currently 4. Should reduce fragmentation.

jamal: prepared a one-line hotpatch — ready to apply after sanity checks:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/cont-batch-runtime PREFETCH_HEURISTIC=off MICROBATCH_MAX_DELAY_MS=8 --record
```

alice: go for it. I'll run canary first on slot-c (low-traffic) then scale to slot-a/b if metrics look good.

ops-bot: deploybot: Starting rollout: set env for deploy/cont-batch-runtime -> canary slot-c (1 pod).

(1m later)

alice: canary metrics - queue_delay.p99 down 40%, evictions/sec down 85% on canary pod. microbatch size median increased from 1 to 5. Looks promising.

jamal: rolling to slot-a/b now. I'll keep concurrency throttle in place: per-tenant qps limit for customers tagged 'high-burst' set to 60% of usual for next 30m.

kevin: notifying impacted customers: sending template update to XYZ and a note to support queue that we're mitigating with config hotpatch, ETA 20m for full rollout.

alice: rolling completed. monitoring across prod-cluster-7: p99 latency trending down toward baseline. still seeing a handful of timeouts from long-tail tenants.

maria: digging into root cause follow-up: we should add a guard to prefetch heuristic to avoid prefetching more than N prefixes per tenant under high concurrency and to coordinate with the microbatching backpressure signal. filing an RFC/bug.

jamal: quick note for oncall handoff - leaving in 30m: current state = mitigated (config off + throttle), customer impact = reduced latency, some residual 500s clearing. follow-up work: revert heuristic or make it concurrency-aware, add telemetry to correlate prefetch volume -> evictions.

alice: handoff to jamal in 25. docs updated in incident channel.

kevin: support: sent proactive messages to 3 customers, logging ticket IDs: #7892 #7893 #7894. asked customers to retest.

maria: postmortem items I'm adding:
- Revert or patch prefetch heuristic: limit per-tenant prefetch under concurrency.
- Add runtime feature flag to dynamically disable prefetch under high evictions.
- Add alert that triggers when microbatch median falls below 2 AND prefetch rate > threshold.
- Add dashboard linking per-tenant request fanout -> KV footprint.

ops-bot: pagerlog: incident 4367890000 marked mitigated at 4367890280 by alice.

jamal: taking over oncall. leaving token: `handoff:jamal` — I'll monitor 1h and then update postmortem draft. any remaining actions for night?

alice: nothing urgent; just ensure the throttle is kept until the heuristic patch is live or we revert the change.

kevin: customers confirmed improved perf for 2 of 3. will close tickets once fully verified.

maria: creating follow-up ticket and assigning to infra-team: INFRA-2026. attaching traces and logs.

jamal: thanks team. putting this in the oncall log and incident board. if anything regresses ping me directly or escalate to @pagerduty. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
